meta.name: newsletter-sponsorship-finder
meta.description: Find newsletters relevant to a target audience/industry for sponsorship opportunities. Discovers newsletters through web search, newsletter directories, and industry research. Returns newsletter name, author, estimated audience, topic focus, sponsorship rates (if available), and contact info.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现适合赞助的行业邮件通讯
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在寻找目标行业的邮件通讯进行广告投放。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're looking for newsletters to sponsor in your target industry.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你描述的目标受众和行业关键词，搜索网络和新闻通讯目录，找出适合投放赞助的新闻通讯，并返回名称、作者、预估读者数、赞助费用（如有）和联系方式等信息。
howto.when: 当你提供目标受众描述和行业关键词时触发。例如，你说“找适合赞助的新闻通讯，目标受众是初创公司CTO，行业关键词是云、AWS”。

say.text: 找适合赞助的新闻通讯，目标受众是初创公司CTO，行业关键词是云、AWS。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并列出相关新闻通讯。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can search the web and newsletter directories to find newsletters suitable for sponsorship based on your target audience and industry keywords, returning name, author, estimated audience, sponsorship rates (if available), and contact info.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a target audience description and industry keywords. For example, when you say 'Find sponsorship opportunities for CTOs at startups in cloud/AWS.'

say_en.text: Find sponsorship opportunities for CTOs at startups in cloud and AWS.
say_en.note: Claude will search and list relevant newsletters.

say_en.text: Find newsletters for DevOps engineers, keywords DevOps, Kubernetes, budget $500-2000 per placement.
